excluded.First test: Baseline calendar date — temporal/cohort information; not a physiological predictor.
excluded.event_date: Death/censoring date — future relative to baseline PFT; outcome timing leakage.
excluded.dead or alive: Mortality/censoring outcome after follow-up — outcome leakage for diagnosis classification.
excluded.survival time: Days from First test to event_date — follow-up/outcome duration leakage.
excluded.age at event: Age at death or censoring (event_date), NOT age at baseline PFT. Equals approximately paper baseline Age + survival_years. Temporal leakage.
excluded.diagnosis group: Target variable y — must not appear in X.

age_at_event_interpretation: B — age at later follow-up/event (death or censoring), not baseline PFT age
preprocessing_rule: Any preprocessing whose parameters are learned from data must be fitted using training data only and then applied to the test data.
checks: PASS: all excluded leakage/id fields absent from X
INFO: identical feature+label row strings shared across splits: 0 (coincidence possible; indices disjoint)
PASS: all 4 classes present in train
PASS: all 4 classes present in test
